thread:
josh_acme: Hey team — our trial credits expired yesterday in the middle of an integration run. We had a promo code that never got applied and now the credits are gone. Can someone help reinstate or extend? Account: acct_abc123. Tracked since 2025-12-01.

maria_support: Sorry to hear that, Josh. Can you drop the account id again and a screenshot of the credits page? If anything sensitive, DM me. Also: did you try redeeming the promo via the dashboard or API?

credits-bot: Audit note: Credits issued -> issued_at: 2025-12-01T14:23:54Z; amount: $200; expires_at: 2026-03-01T14:23:54Z; issuer: promo-system.

josh_acme: Thanks — account is acct_abc123 (same as earlier). I attempted to apply promo code `WELCOME50` on 2026-02-28 via the web console and also tried the API:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/acct_abc123/promos \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -d '{"code":"WELCOME50"}'
```
Response was: `{"error":"promo_not_applicable","reason":"code_already_redeemed"}` — but we never redeemed it. Screenshot: https://files.example.com/scrn-20260228.png

maria_support: Thanks — I'll escalate to billing. @ana_billing can you take a look and confirm whether the promo was applied or credits were consumed? Also help with policy on expired trial credits.

ana_billing: Hi @maria_support, @josh_acme — billing note: our standard policy is trial credits expire 90 days after issuance unless otherwise specified on the promo. For the audit: I can run an admin query but need either the transaction id or confirmation of the login email used. Quick repro for internal check: run `rbx-admin credits list --account acct_abc123` or visit Admin Console -> Billing -> Credits -> search acct_abc123. If you can share the UI screenshot you linked that's helpful.

josh_acme: No transaction id — we were just running test calls (no purchases). The screenshot above is from the account credits page showing 0 credits. The promo redemption attempt log from our side is attached in the screenshot. We weren't charged. Trial issued 2025-12-01, expired 2026-03-01 per the bot.

ana_billing: Understood. I'll open an escalation. Policy-wise: if the expiry is >90 days we typically can't auto-reinstate, but we do a manual manager review for one-time exceptions (especially if the credits expired during a suspected outage or system issue). I'll open an approval ticket -> ES-2026-88 and request a one-time courtesy credit. Expect a 24–48h turnaround. I'll also ask infra to check for any promo-service errors around 2026-02-28 that could explain the `code_already_redeemed` noise.

credits-bot: Escalation created: ES-2026-88 by ana_billing. Linked audit: promo_attempts for acct_abc123 -> 2026-02-28T16:02:12Z: result=promo_not_applicable(code_already_redeemed).

maria_support: Thanks Ana. Josh — once Ana confirms outcome we'll either reinstate or grant a short-window credit. In the meantime: quick prevention tip — when you sign up, redeem the promo first, then run the integration. Also `redwood credits status --account acct_abc123` will show active credits immediately.

josh_acme: Appreciate the follow-up. One more datapoint: our integration was flaky that week — requests were timing out and we retried a ton. Not sure if that triggered anything server-side.

ana_billing: Manager reviewed and approved a one-time reinstatement as a courtesy. I've added $100 in trial credits to acct_abc123. New credits expiration: 30 days from now (temporary window). You should receive an email and see it in the console within 10 minutes. Ticket ES-2026-88 -> updated to `approved_by_manager`.

josh_acme: Confirmed — I can see the $100 in the credits list and the email arrived. Thanks so much for the fast help.

maria_support: Great — marking this resolved from CS side. We'll keep an eye on promo-service logs and follow up if we find a bug. If you see the `promo_not_applicable` again, please paste the full API response and we can repro in staging. :thumbsup:
